install.title: Install the app
install.text: Add Bookeeper to your Home Screen to open it like a real app.
install.iosTitle: How to add it on iPhone
install.ios1: Tap Share in the Safari toolbar.
install.ios2: Scroll and choose Add to Home Screen.
install.ios3: Tap Add at the top right.
